contract: one font file read from memory; every face of a collection, each opened and read in turn
per face: metrics and style flags; family, style and PostScript names; OS/2 weight; every name record
every cmap subtable of formats 0, 4, 6, 10, 12 and 13 with every mapping, and the text charmap libass selects
the kerning of every pair the kern table lists, sorted and unique, nonzero values only
for every glyph its hmtx advance, its loaded advance and its unscaled outline in font units (FT_LOAD_NO_SCALE); packets count glyph outlines and bytes their points
the file is read before each timed and memory operation; the reference library is created once, outside it
